answer: Require every new agent to post a refundable deposit that an established voucher must bond alongside it. Misbehave, and both stakes are slashed. A sybil farm can't pool one reserve like shared saffron; each fake identity becomes its own island needing separate capital, and no honest node in the vouching atlas will risk bonding anonymous strangers. Faking N agents means N real deposits plus a trusted co-signer per fake, so the attack cost scales linearly while a single genuine agent pays once.
